visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short, reddish-tinted hair, wearing a white t-shirt and a grey apron, stands in a bright, modern kitchen. She smiles broadly while drinking a vibrant green liquid from a clear measuring glass, expressing visible enjoyment. Behind her, wooden cabinets and a clean countertop are visible under soft, bright indoor lighting. (2) Close-up shot focusing on hands placing fresh, green okra pods into a metal sieve inside a bowl of water for washing. The movement is deliberate as the pods are swished through the water. The background shows a wooden shelf with kitchen essentials, maintaining a clean and domestic atmosphere. (3) A black pot sits on a stove with water reaching a rolling boil. A hand enters the frame holding a small metal measuring spoon, carefully adding white salt into the bubbling water. The lighting remains bright, emphasizing the steam and the clarity of the water's surface. (4) Using a metal strainer, the washed okra pods are lowered into the boiling salted water. The camera angle is eye-level, focusing on the green pods submerging. Text overlays appear at the bottom, providing instructions for blanching the vegetables to keep them fresh. (5) After a short boil, the okra pods are scooped out with a strainer and immediately plunged into a metal bowl filled with clear ice water. This visual sequence highlights the preservation of the vegetables' bright green color through rapid cooling, with ice cubes clearly visible in the water. (6) On a clean wooden cutting board, a hand uses a silver peeler to remove the brown skin of a kiwi and the red skin of an apple. The fruits are placed on a small stainless steel tray. The camera remains steady, providing a clear view of the smooth peeling motions. (7) The peeled apple is placed on the wooden board and sliced into small cubes with a sharp kitchen knife. The core is carefully removed and discarded. The scene switches between eye-level and top-down perspectives to show the precision of the fruit preparation process. (8) The cooled okra is removed from the ice water and placed on the cutting board. A knife slices the okra into small, cross-sectional rounds, revealing the white seeds inside. The background stays consistent, showing a professional yet cozy home kitchen environment. (9) Diced apples and sliced okra are presented in small white and green ceramic bowls. The camera zooms in slightly to emphasize the fresh textures of the prepared ingredients. This shot acts as a summary of the components ready for the next step. (10) The pieces of apple, kiwi, and okra are poured into a transparent plastic blender jar. Three clear ice cubes and a small beaker of cold water are added to the mix. The shot size is close-up, capturing the layered ingredients inside the container. (11) The blender jar is placed on its base, and the device is switched on. The contents quickly transform from distinct pieces into a thick, uniform green smoothie. The camera follows the motion as the liquid swirls and blends into a smooth consistency. (12) The finished green smoothie is poured from the blender jar into a clear measuring glass. The pour is steady, showing the creamy and thick texture of the 'green latte'. The vibrant color is the central focus of this shot, framed against the wooden tabletop. (13) The host reappears on screen, holding a yellow and white box. She takes out a small green sachet, tears it open, and pours a clear oil into the smoothie. She uses a wooden spoon to stir the mixture thoroughly, looking at the camera with a friendly expression. (14) Using the wooden spoon, she takes a taste of the mixture and nods in approval. She then takes a large sip directly from the glass and gives a thumbs up to the viewer. Information about her social media channels appears as text overlays at the bottom of the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful, medium-tempo BGM featuring upbeat acoustic guitar strumming and a light, rhythmic whistling melody. There is a sense of optimism and energy. No ambient noise is present, suggesting a controlled studio environment with high clarity and spectral brightness. (2) As the cooking demonstration starts, a male vocal song with English lyrics fades in, characterized by a steady rhythmic beat and acoustic guitar backing. The sound of water rushing into a bowl and the metallic clinking of a sieve are clearly audible as incidental noise events. (3) Precise, percussive thudding sounds of a knife hitting a wooden cutting board occur in a rhythmic pattern, synchronized with the visual fruit preparation. The bubbling of water in a pot provides a continuous high-frequency texture, creating a busy yet organized acoustic atmosphere in the kitchen. (4) A loud, sustained broadband noise from a blender motor dominates the audio mix for several seconds. The mechanical whirring has high intensity, partially masking the background music. Once the blending finishes, the sound quickly transitions back to the melodic acoustic guitar track and male vocals. (5) A female voice with a friendly, professional tone begins a Mandarin narration. Her pitch is moderate, and her speech rate is natural with clear articulation. She describes the nutritional benefits of the ingredients. Occasional sounds of liquid pouring and a wooden spoon clinking against a glass provide texture to the speech.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a health-oriented cooking tutorial aimed at teaching viewers how to prepare an 'okra green latte' smoothie. It integrates product placement for a specific perilla oil, positioning the drink as a digestive aid and health supplement.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The host presents a branded box of perilla oil, adds it to her smoothie, and explains its specific health benefits such as Omega-3 content and anti-inflammatory properties.
